instructions:
figma-mcp-express - to build: browse the capability, then drill.
  search_batch_ops(category) -> get_batch_op_spec(op) -> batch(ops:[...])
  How / when / craft: load the figma-design-patterns skill.

Don't default to flat fills + basic shadow. Capabilities by intent
(browse the category that fits, then drill for params):
  depth/realism        -> category:effects     (incl. glass, noise, texture, progressive-blur, shadows)
  responsive layout    -> category:layout      (incl. grid, min/max bounds, wrap, fill/hug, constraints)
  theming/tokens       -> category:tokens      (incl. variable binding, per-subtree dark-mode, aliases)
  custom shapes        -> category:vector      (incl. boolean ops, text-on-path, per-corner radius, custom paths)
  components/variants  -> category:components  (incl. variant + exposed props, swap, instance-from-key)
  interactions         -> category:prototype   (incl. reactions, fixed chrome over scroll)
  real media           -> category:media       (incl. real images + filters, svg, video, gif, link preview)
  shared styles        -> category:styles      (incl. shared paint/text/effect/grid styles, reorder)
  dev handoff          -> category:handoff     (incl. annotations, dev resources, selection colors, codegen, slices)
